items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I enjoyed her playing, but I didn't think she could really outplay Mary.

ctx.x: Was she a good piano player?

Yes, she could play. When Mary Lou got sick, they sent for her to play in Mary's place. Yes, she could handle a job, you know. I didn't enjoy -- I enjoyed her playing, but I didn't think she could really outplay Mary.
No, well, there weren't many people that could.
